description: This file defines a provider class for suggesting file extensions in a search interface, including handling pretext changes and filtering extension suggestions based on user input.

classes.name: SearchFileExtensionProvider
classes.description: A provider class that offers file extension suggestions based on user input in a search bar.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the search pretext, filters extension suggestions, and invokes the results callback with matching suggestions.

methods.name: allowDividers
methods.description: Indicates whether dividers are allowed in the suggestion list (returns false).

methods.name: presentationType
methods.description: Returns the presentation type of the provider, which is 'text'.
